stops.title: Baptized in the Jordan
stops.text: John baptizes Jesus in the Jordan, the Spirit descends, and a voice calls him the beloved Son. He is driven into the wilderness to be tested.

stops.title: A busy Sabbath in Capernaum
stops.text: Jesus teaches in the synagogue, frees a man with an unclean spirit, heals Peter's mother-in-law, and by evening the whole town is at the door.

stops.title: Across the lake
stops.text: On the far shore Jesus frees a man who lives among the tombs. The demons ask to go into a herd of pigs, and the people ask Jesus to leave.

stops.title: The region of Tyre
stops.text: Outside Israel, a Gentile mother begs him to free her daughter, and answers him back.

stops.title: A blind man at Bethsaida
stops.text: Jesus heals a blind man in two steps, and the first stage leaves him seeing people like walking trees.

stops.title: Who do you say I am?
stops.text: Peter says Jesus is the Christ. Jesus begins to teach that the Son of Man must suffer, be killed, and rise.

stops.title: Bartimaeus at Jericho
stops.text: A blind beggar named Bartimaeus calls out, throws off his cloak, and follows Jesus on the road up to Jerusalem.

stops.title: The last week in Jerusalem
stops.text: Jesus enters the city, teaches in the temple, is arrested, crucified, and buried. The women find the tomb empty.

real.label: Map of the land from Jerusalem in the south to Caesarea Philippi in the north, drawn from real coordinates. Numbered stops mark where Mark's story moves.

stops.label: Jordan River
stops.locationNote: Mark doesn't say where on the Jordan this happened; the marker is placed for illustration.

stops.label: East side
stops.locationNote: Manuscripts and ancient writers disagree about the name of the place (Gerasenes, Gadarenes, or Gergesenes), so the marker is placed on the lake's east shore for illustration.
